What badges would you like to see in WhoaVerse?

Use the theory of badges & trophies:

If the purpose of badges & trophies for users are personalization and distinguishment, then you want relatively unique and scarce badges (difficult to acquire) so that they have value.

If the purpose of badges & trophies for whoaverse is the creation of incentives for users to do certain things, then you'd just target every wanted behavior with a badge.

I'd like to see a "thoughtful commenter" (maybe not the best name, but you get the point) type of badge happen to encourage more serious, in-depth discussion in some of the more empty areas of whoaverse.

To start it off, you'd need to let people know that the badge even exists and is there to be "won." I assume there will be some carefully defined criteria, but I'd like to nominate /u/MarkW for this. He has my vote of confidence.

I'd also like to see a "broad news coverage" (again, not the best name, someone can do better) type of badge happen to encourage posting a diverse variety of news items. I'd like to nominate /u/lycanfire for this.
